newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent up with NYMEX as mogas fuels rally.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent up with NYMEX as mogas fuels rally.

text.p: August Brent futures were slightly firmer in late afternoon trading on Wednesday as NYMEX traded higher off the back of gasoline.
August Brent, which expires later on Wednesday, was last traded at $18.45 per barrel, up six cents from London.
September was last traded at $18.49, up 12 cents.
NYMEX August crude, trading on ACCESS, was last traded at $19.75 per barrel, up eight cents from New York, which rose 68 to $19.67.
A gasoline rally during New York trading was later supported by the release of bullish API statistics showing a bigger draw than had been expected.
August gasoline rose 1.59 cent per gallon to 59.94 cents in New York and was up a further 0.51 on ACCESS to last trade at 60.45.
Tom James, of Credit Lyonnais Rouse, was unconvinced the rally indicated a turning point for the market.
He said the volume on the rise Tuesday was generated from "panic short covering."
"I would prefer to hold a cautious bearish view and sell into the recent recovery," he said in a daily briefing.
